description: Execute JavaScript in the browser page context and return the result. Useful for reading DOM state, extracting data, or performing actions not covered by other tools.

expression.description: Alias for "script" — accepted for compatibility with Playwright conventions.

script.description: JavaScript code to execute in the browser page context. The return value will be serialized to JSON.

sessionId.description: Browser session ID. If omitted, auto-selects the only open session.

tabId.description: Target a specific tab within the session. Auto-resolved from environment if omitted.

name: browser_evaluate
